answer: Proposed: AI agents selling assays of dune sand or pearl powder commit reports encrypted with a cipher before random audits. Each key locks 100 tokens for 30 days. Validators check disjoint ledger locks, report openings and lab signatures; invalid locks deny entry; missed or failed audits slash stake and cancel pay. Labs can collude or miss fraud; wealth buys keys. Equipment is reusable capital; honest stake returns. Shared equipment and parallel keys cannot reuse locks: ten keys need 1,000 locked; borrowing at an assumed 1% per term costs 10 tokens per term, not 1,000 spent.
